WITH group_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    tr.transreg,
    t.tradekind,
    AVG(cc.prevviol) as group_avg_prevviol
  FROM compliancecase cc
  JOIN transactionrecord tr ON cc.transref = tr.transreg
  JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY tr.transreg, t.tradekind
),
overall_avg_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(group_avg_prevviol) as overall_avg
  FROM group_avgs
),
with_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    ga.tradekind,
    ga.group_avg_prevviol,
    ga.group_avg_prevviol / oa.overall_avg as ratio
  FROM group_avgs ga
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg_calc oa
),
trader_type_avg_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    tradekind,
    AVG(ratio) as trader_type_avg_ratio
  FROM with_ratios
  GROUP BY tradekind
),
matched_rows AS (
  SELECT 
    wr.tradekind,
    wr.group_avg_prevviol,
    wr.ratio,
    ttar.trader_type_avg_ratio
  FROM with_ratios wr
  JOIN trader_type_avg_ratios ttar ON wr.tradekind = ttar.tradekind
),
filtered_rows AS (
  SELECT 
    group_avg_prevviol,
    ratio,
    ratio - trader_type_avg_ratio as difference
  FROM matched_rows
  WHERE ratio > trader_type_avg_ratio
)
SELECT
  AVG(group_avg_prevviol) as avg_group_prevviol,
  AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio,
  AVG(difference) as avg_difference
FROM filtered_rows
